missing_implementations.title: AdaptiveVRAMAllocator — GPU memory allocation is a stub
missing_implementations.claim_section: Speculative Decoding for Latency Reduction; src/llm/FUTURE_ENHANCEMENTS.md §Security/Reliability (VRAM caps for draft model)
missing_implementations.expected: AdaptiveVRAMAllocator::allocateWithFragmentation() allocates real GPU VRAM; handleOutOfMemory() implements OOM recovery strategies (eviction, defragmentation, CPU spilling)
missing_implementations.observed: allocateWithFragmentation() sets *ptr = nullptr and returns aligned_bytes > 0 — no real GPU memory is allocated. handleOutOfMemory() returns false without any recovery action

evidence.stub_lines: lines 127 (// Stub implementation - would integrate with actual GPU allocator), 139 (*ptr = nullptr; // Stub), 145 (// Stub implementation - recovery strategies)

resolution.description: Introduced ActiveVRAMAllocator as a standalone production class. Delegates real GPU memory allocation to GPUMemoryManager (cudaMalloc/CPU-fallback). OOM recovery pipeline: LRU eviction → defragmentation → CPU spilling. AdaptiveVRAMAllocator::allocateWithFragmentation() and handleOutOfMemory() now delegate to ActiveVRAMAllocator. 29 focused tests and a Google Benchmark suite added.

missing_implementations.title: InferenceEngineEnhanced — KV-cache prewarming and embedding-based cache lookup are TODOs
missing_implementations.claim_section: KV-Cache Reuse (Prefix Cache); src/llm/ROADMAP.md §Context caching (KV-cache reuse)
missing_implementations.expected: prewarmCache() pre-computes KV-cache entries for frequent prompts; checkCache() and updateCache() use real embedding similarity for fuzzy cache hits
missing_implementations.observed: prewarmCache() only logs prompt prefixes without computation. checkCache() and updateCache() use a zero vector (dummy_embedding(128, 0.0f)) instead of real embeddings

evidence.todo_lines: line 495 (// TODO: In production, implement actual cache prewarming), line 1131 (// TODO: compute embeddings for similarity-based cache lookup), line 1139 (// Placeholder - not used in current implementation), line 1169 (// TODO: compute actual embeddings and KV cache)

resolution.description: prewarmCache() computes real embeddings via computeEmbeddingForCache(), estimates token IDs, and stores entries in LLMPrefixCache keyed by prompt text. checkCache() uses prompt as key + real embedding → HNSW fuzzy matching. updateCache() stores prompt key, real embedding, and response.text as generated_text. 3 new tests (Tests 21–23) added in tests/test_inference_engine_enhanced.cpp.

missing_implementations.suggested_issue_title: [llm] Implement embedding-based prefix cache lookup in InferenceEngineEnhanced

missing_implementations.title: DocsAssistant — LLM completion macro undefined, returns placeholder
missing_implementations.expected: generateAnswer() generates responses using LLM inference (THEMIS_LLM_COMPLETE macro or direct engine call)
missing_implementations.observed: The call THEMIS_LLM_COMPLETE(prompt.str()) is commented out with // TODO: Undefined macro; the function always returns the hardcoded string '[LLM completion placeholder]'

evidence.placeholder_lines: lines 251-252 (// std::string answer = THEMIS_LLM_COMPLETE(prompt.str()); // TODO: Undefined macro; std::string answer = "[LLM completion placeholder]";)

resolution.description: generateAnswer() now calls THEMIS_LLM_GENERATE(prompt.str()) when THEMIS_ENABLE_LLM is set and EmbeddedLLMManager::instance().isInitialized() is true. Returns a meaningful error string otherwise instead of '[LLM completion placeholder]'. Evidence: src/llm/docs_assistant.cpp lines 249-256.

missing_implementations.suggested_issue_title: [llm] Wire DocsAssistant::generateAnswer() to actual LLM inference engine

missing_implementations.title: AsyncInferenceEngine — RAG context encoding is naive text concatenation
missing_implementations.expected: submitWithRAGContext() encodes RAG documents in a structured format (XML tags, chat template, structured JSON context)
missing_implementations.observed:
RAG context is naively concatenated as 'Context:
<doc>

Question: <prompt>' — no chat template, no structured format, no deduplication

evidence.todo_lines: line 373 (// TODO: Properly encode RAG context in request)

resolution.description: Structured XML-tag format implemented: <system>, <context><document index="N" source="..." relevance="...">, <question>, <answer> — compatible with modern instruction-tuned models. Custom context_template with {{CONTEXT}}/{{QUERY}} placeholders also supported. Evidence: src/llm/async_inference_engine.cpp lines 369-428.

missing_implementations.suggested_issue_title: [llm] Implement structured RAG context encoding in AsyncInferenceEngine::submitWithRAGContext()

missing_implementations.title: Federated inference across distributed nodes — not implemented
missing_implementations.expected: Distributed inference routing across multiple nodes; LLM requests distributed across machines
missing_implementations.observed: No implementation directory, no source files, no headers for federated inference. byzantine_detector.cpp exists for fault detection but no routing layer for distributed inference

evidence.search_result: No matches for 'federated_inference*' or 'distributed_inference*' in src/llm/

summary.note: LLM-MISSING-001 resolved (2026-03-11): ActiveVRAMAllocator implemented with real GPU allocation, LRU eviction, defragmentation and CPU spilling. LLM-MISSING-002 resolved (2026-03-11): prewarmCache/checkCache/updateCache use real embeddings via HNSW fuzzy matching. LLM-MISSING-003 resolved (2026-03-11): DocsAssistant::generateAnswer() wired to THEMIS_LLM_GENERATE. LLM-MISSING-004 resolved (2026-03-11): structured XML-tag RAG context encoding. LLM-MISSING-005 (federated inference, Issue #1928) remains the only open finding — planned, not yet implemented. No stub exists in the critical inference execution path.
